description: A leaked-secret finding detected by OSS secret scanning (gitleaks / trufflehog OSS). encryptedOnly is a structural const enforcing G7: a detected secret value is stored ONLY as a com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope reference (XChaCha20-Poly1305, Signal-wrapped, DID-bound per ADR-2605181100) — NEVER as plaintext anywhere in the record or in kotoba. Detail leg of a com.etzhayyim.aratame.vulnFinding with category=Secret. R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field + encryption gate.

ruleId.description: Secret-detector rule id (e.g. gitleaks rule, trufflehog detector).

location.description: file:line where the candidate secret was found (static location). The match text is NOT included.

secretEnvelopeRef.description: G7: reference to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope (vault ciphertext) holding the detected value. NEVER plaintext (ADR-2605181100).

validated.description: Whether the detector validated the secret as live. Validation MUST be passive (no authenticated use of the credential).
